name: Six-Cycle
definition: The cycle on six vertices, equivalently $Q_3$ with one antipodal pair of vertices deleted.
properties: It is $Q_3^{--}$, the first antipodally punctured hypercube. It is a two-dimensional partial cube, but it is neither ample, a daisy cube, nor a median graph; every proper pc-minor is ample, daisy, and median. It is periphery-free. In the standard embedding $\{000,001,011,111,110,100\}$, conditioning the first coordinate to zero gives $P_3$ after removing the fixed coordinate.
